[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant listed the ingredients for the Thai Basil Stir-Fry sauce:  
- 2 cloves of garlic, minced  
- 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger  
- 2 tablespoons fish sauce  
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce  
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar  
- 1 tablespoon lime juice  
- 1/2 teaspoon Thai chili flakes  
- 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper  
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the sauce, including using high-quality fish sauce, balancing flavors, and tasting and adjusting as needed.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on choosing the right Thai basil, including looking for the specific variety (Ocimum basilicum var. thyrsiflora), checking the aroma, and avoiding basil with brown or yellow leaves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using fresh Thai basil over dried and provided storage tips.
